# MediaPipe Tasks Vision

This directory contains the browser runtime used for local hand tracking.

- Package: `@mediapipe/tasks-vision`
- Version: `0.10.21`
- License: Apache-2.0
- Source package: `https://registry.npmmirror.com/@mediapipe/tasks-vision/-/tasks-vision-0.10.21.tgz`
- Hand model: `hand_landmarker.task`, float16, version 1
- Model source: `https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-models/hand_landmarker/hand_landmarker/float16/1/hand_landmarker.task`

The runtime and model are loaded from this directory so the published site does not depend on a third-party CDN at runtime.
